prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. The ONLY named human protagonist is Zoe. Kit MUST NOT appear. Ignore every other child shown in reference sheets; unnamed adults may appear only when this scene explicitly requires them. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Moon in Daylight; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: An ordinary park under a bright pale-blue late-afternoon sky. A waxing half-Moon is roughly a quarter-turn around the sky from the unseen Sun, not opposite it. Choose a northern-hemisphere viewing angle with the Moon’s right half lit. Sun stays well outside the composition; no looking toward the Sun.
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 5. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): Zoe sees just the cloud.
Required illustration: Zoe’s upward gaze meets the broad opaque cloud where the Moon was. No visible Moon anywhere else in scene.
Exact current state: Moon still hidden; same bench and position.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Continuity: Zoe is the ONLY human; no Kit or animals. Same low brown wooden bench. Exactly ONE broad white cloud; no small decorative clouds. Sky stays bright pale blue and ground sunlit. No visible Sun, stars or glow halo. If Moon is currently visible, render its lit RIGHT HALF as a small white semicircle with straight vertical left edge; unlit half blends into blue sky, no entire white circle, no changing phase. When exact state says cloud occludes Moon, Moon is FULLY INVISIBLE, never outlined or translucent through cloud.

visualReview.note: Cloud remains opaque; Zoe looks upward; Moon entirely hidden.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; no classroom or physical-device observation.
